_what: How every email the sign-in sends looks, moved from old Trillion's email look (src/mail-settings.json palette_roles resolved against the workspace look's start theme, the values src/mail-sender.mjs emailPalette gave on Nov 3 2026; brand and made_with as src/mail-settings.json and src/record-sharing.json gave them). email-message-html.mjs draws each message in it. `brand.image` and `made_with.image` are files of pages/assets, served at the sign-in's assets path, so a mail client fetches them from this computer's own address. A new look is a change of this file.

palette.font: SF Pro Text, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
